sentences.text:
Opposite Parties
 ---------
 Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Sanjay Prasad

---------
 For the Petitioner : Mr. Ayush Kumar Verma, Advocate  For the State : Mr. Gautam Rakesh, A.P.P.

---------
 Order No.03/ Dated: 21.06.2023 Learned counsel for the petitioner is directed to implead the informant as O.P. No. 2 in this case in course of the day.

Issue notice upon the newly added the O.P. No. 2 by the both the process by registered cover with A/D as well as under ordinary process, for which requisites must be filed within two weeks from today,
failing which the case shall stand dismissed without further reference to the Bench.
Put up this case on 01.08.2023.

In the meantime, let a report called for from the learned Secretary D.L.S.A . , Dumka as to whether the informant or the family members of the deceased have filed any case of grant of compensation under the provision of Motor Vehicle Act.

Let the name of Mr. Gautam Rakesh, the learned A.P.P. on behalf of the State be appeared in the daily cause list henceforth.
(Sanjay Prasad, J.) Bibha/
